source.notes: Ground datum sampled from the unchanged GEDTM30 grid at the ordinary bank front midpoint. source.notes: Designer photographs of the completed 2025 main grandstand, especially project-hungaroring-01/02/08/10.jpg, distinguish the ordinary sloping bank from the roof and rear Platinum balcony. Existing OSM building is NOT usable seating. Ordinary bank is an explicit approximate strip: 6m behind the track-facing building edge (plausible 4–8m), 17 rows x 0.85m assumed tread depth (plausible 0.70–1.00m), total 14.45m. Longitudinal ends follow the source building. These dimensions are photo-informed modeling estimates, not a survey or digitized architect plan; aisles and irregular block ends omitted. The full source building boundary is retained separately; no primary photographs are bundled.
